elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement ... IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: transition assistance for up to six (6) months
return or make available for download all Content

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
elements.evidence: in a commonly used, machine-readable format — 'commonly used' is substituted for the position's 'standard' format requirement

elements.element: Return within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Customer's request — the deadline runs from a later Customer request, not from expiry or termination

elements.element: Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: (c) thereafter delete all Content from its systems
certify such deletion to Customer in writing
transition assistance for up to six (6) months
within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Content

reasons: Preferred level is incomplete on two atomic elements: the 30-day data-return deadline is triggered by 'Customer's request' rather than by expiry or termination, so a mandatory post-termination return is made request-contingent; and the format is 'commonly used' rather than the position's 'standard' machine-readable format.

Fix: change '(b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request' to '(b) within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination' and 'commonly used' to 'standard'. The request condition may remain on transition assistance only.

Positively: 6-month duration, then-current rates, deletion after return and written certification all track the preferred position, and the clause does not newly trigger transition duties in a way adverse to Customer.

The insertion is concise, addresses an absent obligation (Section 3.5 covered only accrued payments), leaves the two existing sentences fully effective, and introduces no contradiction; it relies on the Agreement's existing 'Content' term rather than a new undefined term.
As drafted the clause sits at the fallback (≥90 days' assistance plus a 30-day export), so it is acceptable but short of the locked preferred target.
